remarks: Don't miss this stunning 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse in Darien's desirable Villager Pond Complex! This well-maintained end unit is tucked away at the rear of the complex, offering added privacy. The first floor boasts an open floor plan, featuring a spacious living room with a fireplace and sliders leading to the deck, a dining room, a kitchen, and a convenient half bath. Upstairs, you'll find a generous primary suite with vaulted ceilings, a luxurious, updated bath, and 2 additional bedrooms accompanied by an updated full bath with a walk-in shower. The lower level provides ample storage space and versatile possibilities to suit your needs. The association amenities include a beautiful pool and a charming pool house.
